text:
Irene (PM): quick callout  we need to finalize default behaviour for reserved pools + burst for the upcoming milestone. teams need a clear default to use in pilots.
Marco (Eng): short answer: default should be safe for infra. my vote = default throttle when reserve+burst exhausted.
Jules (SRE): agree. throttle reduces noisy neighbor risk. but we need an emergency console action to revoke burst across a tenant's sessions.
Priest (Sales): customers are split. some want auto-billing for overflow during events; others prefer strict caps. can default be throttle but allow opt-in pay-as-you-go per tenant?
Clara (Billing): opt-in pay-as-you-go requires new invoice rows and near-real-time metering. doable but nontrivial. GA should ship with throttle default + opt-in as follow-up.
Irene (PM): sounds like consensus. we also need the revoke flow + audit trail. Jules, how would you design revoke?
Jules (SRE): console button "revoke_burst" that does two things: 1) flips tenant flag to disable burst routing, 2) emits audit event and triggers immediate reclaim job. needs idempotency.
Marco (Eng): implementation notes: admission checks remaining_reserved + remaining_burst; revoke flips remaining_burst to 0 and writes a revoke_event. admission will see it next check. we'll add a short cache-bust TTL for the admission cache.
Irene (PM): acceptance criteria for rollout: API + console to view reserve/burst, billing export with reserved_used and burst_used, revoke_burst action, and SLO replay tests.
Priest (Sales): add sample contract language: "Burst allowance will be consumed before any contracted pay-as-you-go and may be revoked by Redwood for operational safety." i'll draft.
Clara (Billing): add column burst_window_id to exports so we can map events to invoice lines.
Marco (Eng): edge-case: overlapping burst windows from multiple purchases. we'll attribute to earliest active window; YAGNI full pro-rata for MVP. document behavior.
Jules (SRE): monitoring: add an alert when revoke_burst is used >3 times/day for same tenant (possible abuse).
bot-rfc: RFC opened DCR-5012: "reserved-pools GA defaults: throttle, revoke flow, billing columns" linked to roadmap board.
Irene (PM): thanks team. plan: ship throttle default + revoke in first GA. opt-in pay-as-you-go to follow. reconvene after sprint planning. :rocket:
